claim: DOGFOODING FINDING (v1.3.0, first loop-built release): the three-link discharge chain the preregister/discharge skills teach (park under a NON-runnable check -> supersede to repo-check -> gate-sign) trips audit.py two checks, which assume a two-link chain. (1) warn_tdd_precedence: park_supersede_pairs counts the (repo-check -> signed) pair, whose repo-check middle link introduces WITH code (the green commit), yielding a false late-precedence warn even though the ORIGINAL parked claim was ledger-only and preceded the code. (2) report_red_proof_coverage: receipts filed about the SIGNED (3rd-link) claim do not match the (parked, repo-check) pair the counter walks, so coverage undercounts. Fix options for the operator: EITHER audit.py traces a supersedes-chain back to its first ledger-only ancestor before judging precedence and accepts a receipt anywhere on the chain, OR the skills teach the two-link pattern (park the acceptance claim DIRECTLY under repo-check in the ledger-only beat-1 commit; on a code-less commit the gate does not sign it, so nothing auto-signs). The v1.3.0 loop discipline itself held: clm-0006/clm-0011 were ledger-only claim-first commits, and both detector slices carry red-proof receipts (clm-0010, clm-0015).
subject: loop-machinery-finding
